p2.note: EN altered the al-Asas quote «وأما لك في هذا المكان منفسح» to a statement and mistranslated «وأنشأت أي نهضت»; EN also inserted Arabic words into quotations and changed «نشيئا»/«الثواب» in the quoted Arabic (now as written with notes). TR had unmarked glosses «yani ölümüne savaştılar» and «(son durumda)», removed.
TR expanded al-Zamakhshari quote «قوما مؤمنين» to «Allah’a ve âhiret gününe inanan bir kavim»; fixed to «mü’min bir kavim».
EN had unmarked addition «[which operates like «ليس»]» after «ما نافية حجازية» (and a stray «[Then]»); removed.

p1.note: English is complete and faithful, but the Translator note after "to a seventh?" asserts that the following wording matches Ibn Abi al-Isba in Tahrir al-Tahbir; I cannot verify this attribution from the Arabic (which names no one there), so the note is an unverified claim.

p2.note: TR reversed the fourth question: «ولا يهمل هذا العدد» rendered as «bu sayıyı neden ihmal etmedi» (why did He not neglect); fixed to why He neglected it. Both silently corrected «فلم كان ... ألفيت» (added «not») and «وضعه»; notes added. EN: «لم يتجاوز بها» rendered «beyond six», fixed; unmarked bracket glosses removed; «ساسدهم» misprint noted.
